name: Calculate the customer churn rate between 2009 and 2010.
python_code:
# Calculate customer churn rate between 2009 and 2010
# Churn rate = customers who were active in 2009 but not in 2010 / customers active in 2009

# Convert InvoiceDate to datetime
df['InvoiceDate'] = pd.to_datetime(df['InvoiceDate'])

# Filter out rows with missing Customer ID
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['Customer ID']).copy()

# Get customers active in 2009
customers_2009 = df_clean[df_clean['InvoiceDate'].dt.year == 2009]['Customer ID'].unique()

# Get customers active in 2010
customers_2010 = df_clean[df_clean['InvoiceDate'].dt.year == 2010]['Customer ID'].unique()

# Customers who were active in 2009 but not in 2010
churned_customers = set(customers_2009) - set(customers_2010)

# Calculate churn rate
if len(customers_2009) > 0:
    churn_rate = len(churned_customers) / len(customers_2009)
else:
    churn_rate = 0.0

result = churn_rate
